html:
The Tigray war was fought from November 2020 to November 2022 between the Ethiopian federal government, with Eritrean troops and regional forces, and the rulers of the northern region of Tigray.

The Tigray People's Liberation Front had dominated Ethiopia from 1991 until Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed came to power in 2018 and sidelined it. After Tigrayan forces attacked a federal army base, Abiy sent the army in. Eritrean troops joined against their old enemy.

Massacres, sexual violence and a blockade that cut food and medicine to millions followed. Tigrayan forces pushed toward Addis Ababa in 2021 before being driven back. A peace deal signed at Pretoria ended the fighting in 2022. Estimates of the dead run to hundreds of thousands, many from hunger, recalling the famine of the 1980s in the same region of Ethiopia.
sum: The Tigray war was fought from November 2020 to November 2022 between the Ethiopian federal government, with Eritrean troops and regional forces, and the rulers of the northern region of Tigray.
